info.name: Clan platform - game team: roles, invitations and team management (TEAM-306, TEAM-307, TEAM-308)
info.description: Run the whole collection in order (Runner). Needs the platform service on {{baseUrl}} with migrations up to 000016 (this phase adds none) applied and PLATFORM_EMAIL_VERIFICATION off (the default). Creates its own developers and game, so it can be re-run. Covers who may do what on a game (owner, member, stranger), inviting by email, accepting and declining, the rate limit, and managing the team: removing a member (access stops at once), leaving, changing roles, handing the game over, and the rule that a game keeps one owner. Invite emails are written to the platform's log when no SMTP server is set. Expiry (7 days) is covered by the Go tests and the live script, not here.
